runtime_behavior: Accept only an explicit corpse identity, gold key, seed, and inclusive minimum/maximum gold range
Reconcile zero or identical corpse gold idempotently
Reject conflicting pre-existing corpse gold rather than overwrite it
Reject invalid ranges and cleaned corpses atomically
assumptions: Native NPC gold mappings, RNG, ranges, scaling, and conditional formulas remain unknown
safe_fallback: No NPC corpse gold is generated unless an authoritative caller supplies the complete range, key, and seed.
runtime_impact: Adds deterministic evidence-gated NPC corpse-gold generation.
character_save_impact: None directly. Economy or Character orchestration credits gold only when it is later looted.
world_state_impact: Generated gold is stored in persistent corpse state and follows existing corpse validation and recovery.
native_dependencies: Native gold range and scaling formulas
